prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: the top of thick living-wood walls inside a giant tree, seen from above: dark bark ridges and knotted wood mass with moss. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless repeating game texture, pixel art: overhead surface of thick living-wood walls inside a giant tree, dense interlocking dark bark ridges, knotted wood grain and small irregular moss clusters. Entire image is ONLY this surface edge-to-edge, evenly distributed pattern with no central focal feature, no border or objects. TRUE TILEABILITY is paramount: left boundary lines/colors continue exactly at right boundary, and top boundary continues at bottom boundary, including corners. Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art. A coarse consistent square art-pixel grid, each art pixel rendered as a perfectly sharp identical-size square (roughly 8 screen pixels wide); deliberate 3–10 art-pixel color clusters, chunky beautifully hand-placed shapes and readable bark contours. No antialiasing, blur, soft brushes, photographic texture, noise, checkerboard dithering. Rich earthy limited ramps, 4–6 distinct shades per material: dark reddish-purple and plum brown saturated shadow crevices, warm umber midtones, warm yellow-ochre highlights, muted olive and deep green moss. Classic orthographic top-down RPG map view, neutral soft even upper-left daylight/overcast illumination. Clean base colors only, no cast shadows, nighttime darkening, vignette, glow or light pools. Square texture.
